          (drop): Identity()
        )

        (main): Sequential(
          (0): Conv1dBlock(

            (drop): Identity()

lewm.architecture:
LeWM(
  (engine): MaskedEngine()
  (encoder): ResNetEncoder(
    (blocks): Sequential(
      (0): ResNetBlock(
        (main): Sequential(
          (0): Conv1dBlock(
            (conv): Conv1d(3, 4, kernel_size=(3,), stride=(1,), padding=(1,))
            (norm): Identity()
            (act): GELU(approximate='none')
            (drop): Identity()
          )
          (1): Conv1dBlock(
            (conv): Conv1d(4, 4, kernel_size=(3,), stride=(1,), padding=(1,))
            (norm): Identity()
            (act): GELU(approximate='none')
            (drop): Identity()
          )
        )
        (residual): Conv1dBlock(
          (conv): Conv1d(3, 4, kernel_size=(5,), stride=(1,), padding=(2,))
          (norm): Identity()
          (act): GELU(approximate='none')
          (drop): Identity()
        )
        (act): GELU(approximate='none')
      )
      (1): ResNetBlock(
        (main): Sequential(
          (0): Conv1dBlock(
            (conv): Conv1d(4, 6, kernel_size=(3,), stride=(1,), padding=(1,))
            (norm): Identity()
            (act): GELU(approximate='none')
            (drop): Identity()
          )
          (1): Conv1dBlock(
            (conv): Conv1d(6, 6, kernel_size=(3,), stride=(1,), padding=(1,))
            (norm): Identity()
            (act): Identity()
            (drop): Identity()
          )
        )
        (residual): Conv1dBlock(
          (conv): Conv1d(4, 6, kernel_size=(5,), stride=(1,), padding=(2,))
          (norm): Identity()
          (act): Identity()
          (drop): Identity()
        )
        (act): Identity()
      )
    )
  )
  (action): MaskedRepresentationAction(
    (aux): TimeAuxiliary(
      (convs): Sequential(
        (0): Conv1dBlock(
          (conv): Conv1d(3, 4, kernel_size=(3,), stride=(1,), padding=(1,))
          (norm): Identity()
          (act): GELU(approximate='none')
          (drop): Identity()
        )
        (1): Conv1dBlock(
          (conv): Conv1d(4, 4, kernel_size=(3,), stride=(1,), padding=(1,))
          (norm): Identity()
          (act): GELU(approximate='none')
          (drop): Identity()
        )
      )
      (mask_head): Conv1d(4, 1, kernel_size=(1,), stride=(1,))
    )
  )
  (predictor): FreqPredictor(
    (stem_conv): Conv1dBlock(
      (conv): Conv1d(6, 4, kernel_size=(7,), stride=(1,), padding=(3,))
      (norm): BatchNorm1d(4, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, bias=True, track_running_stats=True)
      (act): GELU(approximate='none')
      (drop): Identity()
    )
    (in_proj): Conv2dBlock(
      (net): Sequential(
        (0): Conv2d(8, 4, kernel_size=(3, 3), stride=(1, 1), padding=(1, 1))
        (1): BatchNorm2d(4, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, bias=True, track_running_stats=True)
        (2): GELU(approximate='none')
        (3): Identity()
      )
    )
    (c0): Conv2dBlock(
      (net): Sequential(
        (0): Conv2d(4, 6, kernel_size=(3, 3), stride=(2, 2), padding=(1, 1))
        (1): BatchNorm2d(6, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, bias=True, track_running_stats=True)
        (2): GELU(approximate='none')
        (3): Identity()
      )
    )
    (c1): Conv2dBlock(
      (net): Sequential(
        (0): Conv2d(6, 8, kernel_size=(3, 3), stride=(2, 2), padding=(1, 1))
        (1): BatchNorm2d(8, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, bias=True, track_running_stats=True)
        (2): GELU(approximate='none')
        (3): Identity()
      )
    )
    (c2): Conv2dBlock(
      (net): Sequential(
        (0): Conv2d(8, 8, kernel_size=(3, 3), stride=(1, 1), padding=(1, 1))
        (1): BatchNorm2d(8, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, bias=True, track_running_stats=True)
        (2): GELU(approximate='none')
        (3): Identity()
      )
    )
    (up2): Conv2dBlock(
      (net): Sequential(
        (0): Conv2d(14, 6, kernel_size=(3, 3), stride=(1, 1), padding=(1, 1))
        (1): BatchNorm2d(6, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, bias=True, track_running_stats=True)
        (2): GELU(approximate='none')
        (3): Identity()
      )
    )
    (up1): Conv2dBlock(
      (net): Sequential(
        (0): Conv2d(10, 4, kernel_size=(3, 3), stride=(1, 1), padding=(1, 1))
        (1): BatchNorm2d(4, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, bias=True, track_running_stats=True)
        (2): GELU(approximate='none')
        (3): Identity()
      )
    )
    (down_p0): Conv2dBlock(
      (net): Sequential(
        (0): Conv2d(4, 4, kernel_size=(3, 3), stride=(2, 2), padding=(1, 1))
        (1): BatchNorm2d(4, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, bias=True, track_running_stats=True)
        (2): GELU(approximate='none')
        (3): Identity()
      )
    )
    (pan1): Conv2dBlock(
      (net): Sequential(
        (0): Conv2d(10, 6, kernel_size=(3, 3), stride=(1, 1), padding=(1, 1))
        (1): BatchNorm2d(6, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, bias=True, track_running_stats=True)
        (2): GELU(approximate='none')
        (3): Identity()
      )
    )
    (final): Conv2dBlock(
      (net): Sequential(
        (0): Conv2d(10, 4, kernel_size=(3, 3), stride=(1, 1), padding=(1, 1))
        (1): BatchNorm2d(4, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, bias=True, track_running_stats=True)
        (2): GELU(approximate='none')
        (3): Identity()
      )
    )
    (out_proj): Conv2d(4, 8, kernel_size=(1, 1), stride=(1, 1))
    (to_latent): Conv1d(4, 6, kernel_size=(1,), stride=(1,))
    (film0): TimeFiLM(
      (to_gamma): Conv1d(4, 6, kernel_size=(1,), stride=(1,))
      (to_beta): Conv1d(4, 6, kernel_size=(1,), stride=(1,))
    )
    (film1): TimeFiLM(
      (to_gamma): Conv1d(4, 8, kernel_size=(1,), stride=(1,))
      (to_beta): Conv1d(4, 8, kernel_size=(1,), stride=(1,))
    )
    (film2): TimeFiLM(
      (to_gamma): Conv1d(4, 8, kernel_size=(1,), stride=(1,))
      (to_beta): Conv1d(4, 8, kernel_size=(1,), stride=(1,))
    )
  )
)

  (engine): ForecastEngine()
  (encoder): ResNetEncoder(
    (blocks): Sequential(
      (0): ResNetBlock(
        (main): Sequential(
          (0): Conv1dBlock(

            (norm): Identity()
            (act): GELU(approximate='none')
            (drop): Identity()
          )
        )
        (residual): Conv1dBlock(
          (conv): Conv1d(3, 4, kernel_size=(5,), stride=(1,), padding=(2,))
          (norm): Identity()
          (act): GELU(approximate='none')
          (drop): Identity()
        )
        (act): GELU(approximate='none')
      )
      (1): ResNetBlock(
        (main): Sequential(
          (0): Conv1dBlock(
            (conv): Conv1d(4, 6, kernel_size=(3,), stride=(1,), padding=(1,))
            (norm): Identity()
            (act): GELU(approximate='none')
            (drop): Identity()
          )

            (norm): Identity()
            (act): Identity()
            (drop): Identity()

        )
        (residual): Conv1dBlock(

          (norm): Identity()
          (act): Identity()
          (drop): Identity()
        )
        (act): Identity()
      )
    )
  )
  (action): EncoderAction(
    (net): TCNEncoder(
      (net): Sequential(
        (0): CausalConv1dBlock(
          (net): Sequential(
            (0): CausalConv1d(6, 4, kernel_size=(3,), stride=(1,))

    (value): Conv1d(6, 4, kernel_size=(1,), stride=(1,))
    (to_latent): ConvTranspose1d(4, 6, kernel_size=(3,), stride=(1,), padding=(1,))

      (head): Identity()
      (input_projection): Identity()
    )
  )
)
